request.deadline: 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Hardening, security audits, and formal verification
Stewardship structure and economic foundations for launch
Audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in federated and SPO-threshold custody modes under controlled access
Public rollout and 24 months of operations deferred to Phase 2 in Q1 2027
request.what: Phase 1 of 2 funding to take Bifrost from working testnet to launch readiness for a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's existing SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as a native Cardano asset.
The proposal requests ₳12,332,031, approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA including a 10% refundable contingency, for Phase 1 delivery.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO-threshold custody modes under controlled access.
Bifrost is already live on testnet under Catalyst Fund 14 with working peg-ins and peg-outs and participating SPOs.
Bifrost's prior Catalyst Fund 14 grant was ₳739,000 for architecture, testnet MVP, and documentation, with milestones M1 and M2 marked done and approved in the document.

The proposer claims custody of locked BTC will be distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs weighted by delegation, with movement of funds requiring a cryptographic threshold representing the majority of delegated stake.
The proposer claims Bifrost has no bridge token, no founder allocation, open-source Apache 2.0 smart contracts, off-chain tooling and SDK, and public reporting by default.
The proposer targets 1,200 BTC TVL, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets by Q2 2029 as Bifrost's base contribution to Cardano 2030 KPIs.
The proposer claims bridge fees in fBTC will fund operations and that surplus will be split to SPOs and the Cardano Treasury.

summary: The document describes a large treasury request for Phase 1 launch-readiness work on Bifrost, a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge, with stated technical, economic, stewardship, and adoption goals but limited independently verifiable evidence in the supplied text.
